items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: You heard that time when they whip up Papa Celestad's band? No, nobody ever told us that.

ctx.x: Out at West End? No, no.

Down that way? Not that out in Semonaut Parish. Oh no, I don't know. There's never been down there much. There's Delacro Island. Delacro Island, that's it. Is that it? Yeah. I seen them people fight down there so that it was scary to look at them. It was cold. It was cold and raining. Ice fall on the ground. They fight and they cut up one another and roll all underneath the cars and everything. You heard that time when they whip up Papa Celestad's band? No, nobody ever told us that. Yeah, the whip up Papa…
Was there a picnic ground there or something?
